summary: Advance as many unfinished authorized requirements as available execution permits.
text: Continue working autonomously toward 100% completion of the established scope. Execute as many meaningful unfinished roadmap tasks as the available session permits, implementing, testing, and committing repeatedly. Never return merely because one task finished, a checkpoint was reached, or one task is blocked; move to other legitimate unfinished work when possible. Do not invent scope or waste time on redundant planning. Return only when further productive execution is genuinely unavailable or the execution limit is reached. Report the verified overall completion percentage, its change, evidence of progress, and remaining work. Follow all established rules.

situation.trigger: The ongoing agent has reported satisfactory progress and additional agreed work remains.
situation.purpose: Continue an active, already authorized project after a satisfactory work update.

intent.outcome: Advance as many unfinished authorized requirements as available execution permits.

appropriate_when: A development interaction is already underway
The user wants sustained continuation, not a new project plan
not_appropriate_when: The user is asking only for a diagnosis
No authorized work or objective is established
preconditions: Recover the current roadmap and established instructions when necessary

execution.objective: Continue an active, already authorized project after a satisfactory work update.

tradeoffs: The phrase about reaching full completion does not itself establish a measurable denominator
A prompt cannot guarantee a specific execution duration
